artifacts.label: Intake Preflight
notes: Source coverage, offsets, hashes, deadlines, and missing facts ready for review.

artifacts.label: Human Gate
notes: Principal party roles and representation posture still require confirmation.

artifacts.label: Conflict Seed
notes: Seed terms only; no conflict conclusion.

artifacts.label: Budget Proposal
notes: Critical L&E budget facts are missing, including party count and discovery scope.

artifacts.label: Matter Opening
notes: Conflicts and engagement remain unresolved.

artifacts.label: Budget Submission Guard
notes: No client or carrier submission authorized.

artifacts.label: Lake Handoff
notes: Candidate labels only; no SQLite or Lake admission.

artifacts.label: Run Ledger Integrity
notes: Gate order and no-write flags verified.

artifacts.label: Budget Coherence
notes: Serialized budget totals, headline scenario, estimate basis, and display boundary validated.

artifacts.label: Synthetic QA Bundle
notes: Local QA evidence is bundled for review; calibration remains blocked until replay and reviewed-gold evidence mature.

artifacts.label: Synthetic QA Review Run
notes: The one-command synthetic QA recipe generated all local QA and UI review artifacts.

artifacts.label: Matter-Linking Preflight
notes: Upfront-like document clusters are resolved only as human-gated candidates.

artifacts.label: Synthetic Fixture Depth
notes: Depth audit tracks fixture-family breadth, holdouts, red-team coverage, and remaining L&E gaps.

artifacts.label: Calibration Readiness
notes: Calibration remains blocked until reviewed synthetic fixture evidence and replay outputs are sufficient.

artifacts.label: Calibration Starter Pack
notes: Synthetic QA starter evidence can exercise the calibration chain but does not replace real human fixture-update review.

artifacts.label: L&E QA Matrix
notes: L&E synthetic fact fixtures prove critical blockers and range-only review posture before budget QA is trusted.

artifacts.label: L&E Fixture Family Pack
notes: L&E fixture coverage includes required families, clean/messy/missing/adversarial variants, fact needs, and budget-driver dimensions.

artifacts.label: L&E Executable Fixtures
notes: Selected L&E source bundles execute through deterministic preflight before fixture generation is trusted.

artifacts.label: L&E Executable Coverage
notes: QA shows which L&E fixture-family pack cases are executable today and which remain planned coverage gaps.

artifacts.label: L&E Executable Fact Binding
notes: Executable preflight evidence is bound to expected L&E budget-fact gaps without resolving facts or producing an amount budget.

artifacts.label: L&E Executable Driver Binding
notes: Executable fact-gap evidence is mapped to L&E budget-driver focus dimensions without resolving driver values or producing an amount budget.

artifacts.label: L&E Executable Driver Impact
notes: Executable driver bindings declare candidate budget blockers, range widening, scenario forks, and rate/guideline review effects before budget math can consume them.

artifacts.label: L&E Driver Impact Review
notes: Reviewed synthetic evidence selects the nonblocking driver-impact slice used for budget-gate replay.

artifacts.label: L&E Blocked Driver Impact Review
notes: Blocked amount-budget driver impacts list critical fact blockers, follow-up actions, and candidate Lake labels.

artifacts.label: L&E Budget Fact Gold
notes: L&E budget fact audit outputs are replayed against reviewed synthetic gold before calibration or model comparison.

artifacts.label: Budget Human Review
notes: Reviewer must confirm assumptions, unknowns, and prohibited next steps.

artifacts.label: Carrier Rejection Ledger
notes: Future rejection and appeal outcomes stay append-only evidence.

artifacts.label: Actual Variance Ledger
notes: Budget-to-actual variance is a candidate learning surface only.

artifacts.label: Public Methodology
notes: Public records are used for structure review only, not runtime facts.

artifacts.label: Public Data Cache
notes: Ignored local cache manifest and hashes require human review before conversion.

qualityGates.label: Budget Coherence
notes: Serialized artifact math and no-submission display banner are checked before demo acceptance.

qualityGates.label: Synthetic QA Bundle
notes: Budget coherence, fixture depth, calibration readiness, and UI evidence are bundled for QA review.

qualityGates.label: Synthetic QA Review Run
notes: The one-command synthetic QA recipe proves each generated QA/UI artifact step before frontend review.

qualityGates.label: Matter-Linking Preflight
notes: Upfront-like document clusters must stay human-gated and no-write before budget or matter-opening workflows rely on them.

qualityGates.label: Synthetic Fixture Depth
notes: Fixture-family depth is visible but still needs larger L&E coverage and holdout review.

qualityGates.label: Calibration Readiness
notes: Budget calibration is blocked until reviewed gold, replay outcomes, and variance evidence exist.

qualityGates.label: L&E QA Matrix
notes: L&E synthetic fact fixtures must prove critical blockers and range-only review posture.

qualityGates.label: L&E Fixture Family Pack
notes: L&E synthetic fixtures must cover required families, variants, fact needs, and budget-driver dimensions.

qualityGates.label: L&E Executable Fixtures
notes: Selected L&E source bundles must execute through deterministic preflight before fixture generation is trusted.

qualityGates.label: L&E Executable Coverage
notes: QA must show which L&E fixture-family pack cases are executable today and which remain planned coverage gaps.

qualityGates.label: L&E Executable Fact Binding
notes: Executable L&E preflight packets must bind expected budget-fact gaps to source evidence, source inventory, or dry-run exception labels.

qualityGates.label: L&E Executable Driver Binding
notes: Executable L&E fact-gap evidence must map to budget-driver focus dimensions before budget-driver QA is trusted.

qualityGates.label: L&E Executable Driver Impact
notes: Executable L&E driver bindings must declare candidate budget blockers, range widening, scenario forks, and rate/guideline review effects before budget math can consume them.

qualityGates.label: L&E Driver Impact Review
notes: Nonblocking L&E driver-impact budget-gate replay must be backed by reviewed synthetic evidence, not hand-filtered test data.

qualityGates.label: L&E Blocked Driver Impact Review
notes: Blocked L&E amount-budget cases must explain blocker facts, follow-up actions, and candidate Lake labels before QA trusts budget gating.

qualityGates.label: L&E Budget Fact Gold
notes: L&E budget fact audit outputs must match reviewed synthetic gold before calibration or model comparison.

qualityGates.label: Full Pytest
notes: Use the repo wrapper so focused and full tests receive the configured long timeout ceiling.

qualityGates.label: North-Star Smoke
notes: North-star smoke runs the local checkout, budget coherence, starter audit, blocked-budget audit, and counterfactual audit.

blockerSummary: Human confirmation required for matter family, posture, and principal party roles.
Critical L&E budget facts missing: party count, class/collective posture, discovery scope, ESI custodians.
No conflict conclusion, matter opening, budget submission, public runtime ingestion, or Lake write is authorized.
redTeamNotes: Budget math must not invent rates, parties, staffing levels, or discovery scope from context priors.
Public data can shape synthetic fixtures only after cache, methodology, conversion, and human review gates pass.
Carrier rejection learning must remain append-only and shadow-evaluated before any owner adoption.
